# Treatment of Periprosthetic Hip and Knee Joint Infections

# Patient Classification:

No beta-lactam allergy: gram-positive and/or non-pseudomonas gram-negative infection
Cefuroxime and vancomycin ALBC order set

# Patient Classification:

Beta-lactam allergy, any infecting organism OR No beta-lactam allergy, but with documented pseudomonas infection
Aztreonam and vancomycin ALBC order set
